summary: File upload functionality testing complete. Backend: 13/13 tests passed (100%). All upload endpoints working correctly - single file upload (image returns data URL, audio returns streaming URL), multiple file upload with song_name extraction from filename, audio streaming with Range header support for seeking, and file metadata retrieval.

issues: No audio file upload input in choir's Upload Song modal - only metadata fields (title, album, duration, lyrics). This appears to be by design as choir uploads require admin approval.

POST /api/upload - Audio upload returns streaming URL (/api/files/{id}/stream)
POST /api/upload - MP3 upload returns streaming URL
POST /api/upload/multiple - Multiple audio files upload with song_name extracted from filename
POST /api/upload/multiple - Mixed files (audio + image) handled correctly
GET /api/files/{file_id}/stream - Range header support (bytes=0-9 returns 206 Partial Content)
GET /api/files/{file_id} - File metadata returned without data field
Integration - Upload thumbnail and create album with thumbnail URL
Integration - Upload audio and create song with streaming URL

Frontend Choir Dashboard - My Content tab shows albums and Upload Song button
Frontend Choir Dashboard - Upload Song modal opens with form fields
critical_code_review_comments: Backend upload endpoints correctly implemented with proper file size limits (50MB audio, 5MB images)
Audio files return streaming URLs (/api/files/{id}/stream) instead of data URLs for efficient playback
Streaming endpoint supports HTTP Range headers for audio seeking (returns 206 Partial Content)

UserStreamingApp correctly prepends BACKEND_URL to relative streaming URLs
AlbumsPage handleFileUpload function uses /api/upload endpoint correctly
Bulk song upload in AlbumsPage extracts song titles from filenames by removing extension
